environment.description: Same application on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The task IAM role has an attached permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/ContainerSecurityBoundary). The container runs with a read-only root filesystem enforced via ECS task definition (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) with a tmpfs mount at /tmp only. The ALB has a listener rule that applies a fixed-response 403 for any request where the query string length exceeds 128 bytes (configured as a query-string condition with pattern matching). Additionally, the container's /app/data directory is mounted as a read-only bind from an EFS access point (access point policy: uid=1000, gid=1000, permissions=0555, root directory /prod/data) with the IAM authorization requiring the elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite action which is explicitly denied in the task role's permission boundary. The SQLite database is therefore opened in read-only mode at runtime (sqlite3 raises OperationalError on any write attempt including the audit_log INSERT).
